channels.title: BibleProject - Français
channels.description:
BibleProject élabore des ressources gracieusement offertes pour vous aider à expérimenter la Bible. Tout ce que nous produisons est financé par de généreux donateurs à travers le globe. Pour en savoir plus et voir toutes nos ressources, rendez-vous sur bibleproject.com/francais. 

BibleProject travaille en collaboration avec L’Alliance Biblique Française dans le cadre de la traduction de ses contenus en français. Si vous souhaitez soutenir ces efforts de traduction, vous pouvez faire un don à L’Alliance Biblique Française Française via https://alliancebiblique.fr/bibleproject ou à BibleProject via https://bible.to/fra-c.

Retrouvez-nous sur les autres plateformes:
instagram.com/bibleprojectfrancais
facebook.com/BibleProjectfrancais

Vous parlez une autre langue en plus du français ? Découvrez nos vidéos, posters, et plans de lecture dans plus de 50 autres langues à bibleproject.com/languages.

playlists.title: Advent Word Studies
playlists.description: Advent is an important month in Christian liturgy and religious tradition, as we remember the anticipation of Jesus' birth and together wait for his second coming.

playlists.title: Angels, Cherubim, Demons, and Other Spiritual Beings in the Bible Explained
playlists.description:
The Bible’s story contains a larger cast of characters than just humans and God. Watch these videos to explore the role of spiritual beings in the story of the Bible.

In this playlist, you’ll learn:

* How the biblical authors saw the world
* How the biblical authors talked about spiritual beings
* Who the divine council is in the Bible
* What angels and cherubim are and what they do
* Why the “Angel of the Lord” shows up in the Bible
* Who the Satan and demons are and what their mission is
* How humanity becomes the new humanity through Jesus

Subscribe to our channel for more explainer videos about the Bible. https://www.youtube.com/@bibleproject

Visit our website for more resources to experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus. https://bibleproject.com/

playlists.title: Bad Word Studies
playlists.description: Learn more about “bad words” of the Bible, like sin, iniquity, and transgression.

playlists.title: Better Understand the Law in the Story of the Bible
playlists.description: How should we understand ancient law codes in the Bible? In this playlist, we look to these ancient commandments and then see how Jesus read and understood them as wisdom that pointed to him.

playlists.title: Bible Basics
playlists.description: We’re excited to introduce a new series from BibleProject, Bible Basics. These will be short, one-minute videos aimed at those who are new to biblical study.

playlists.title: BibleProject’s 5 Newest Videos

playlists.title: Biblical Hope for Times of Christian Suffering
playlists.description:
What does the Bible say about suffering? Watch these videos to gain a biblical perspective on suffering and its role in the spiritual world.

In this playlist, you’ll learn…

* Wisdom about how God runs the world
* What it means for God to be compassionate
* What’s behind the pain and suffering in the world
* How suffering opened a new way forward for humanity
* How suffering can bring clarity to the Christian mission

Subscribe to our channel for more explainer videos about the Bible: https://www.youtube.com/@bibleproject

Visit our website for more resources to experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus: https://bibleproject.com/

playlists.title: Discover the Purpose and Meaning of Life
playlists.description:
What was God’s purpose for creating and ordering the cosmos? Watch this playlist to explore how the biblical story reveals its ancient authors' understanding of life’s purpose and meaning.

In this playlist, you’ll learn…

* How the first chapter of the Bible sets the stage of God’s purpose for creation
* What “eternal life” is and why Jesus can offer it
* What the “Tree of Life” represents and how we can eat from it
* The one unified story the Bible is telling throughout all its books
* Why you can trust life has meaning even when you can’t make sense of it

Subscribe to our channel for more explainer videos about the Bible: https://www.youtube.com/@bibleproject

Visit our website for more resources to experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus: https://bibleproject.com/

playlists.title: Discover True Righteousness Through Jesus’ Teachings
playlists.description:
What does Jesus mean when he calls his followers to be righteous? Watch this playlist to explore the meaning of righteousness in the Bible and how Jesus emphasizes it in the Sermon on the Mount.

In this playlist, you’ll learn:

* What it looks like to participate in God’s Kingdom
* How this righteousness relates to the Torah
* How this righteousness relates to religious practices
* How this righteousness is expressed in our relationships with God and with neighbor

Subscribe to our channel for more explainer videos about the Bible: https://www.youtube.com/@bibleproject

playlists.title: Explore Important Passover Themes in the Bible
playlists.description:
Explore Passover’s timeless themes of redemption, sacrifice, justice and more. In this playlist, you’ll learn…

- The events that led to Israel’s salvation from slavery to Egypt
- How God confronts evil and delivers his people
- How God dealt with evil without destroying humanity
- The Bible’s radical view of justice
- God’s plan to restore goodness and blessing to the world
- What happened in the final week of Jesus’ life
- The epic conclusion of Luke's account of Jesus' life and mission on Earth

playlists.title: Get a Biblical Perspective on God’s Justice
playlists.description:
What does the Bible say about justice? Watch these videos to trace this biblical theme and understand how God responds with love and justice to the world.

In this playlist, you’ll learn…

* The foundational principle of the Bible’s view on justice
* What the book of Job teaches us about God’s justice
* How God’s anger relates to justice and His love for the world
* How God dealt with evil without destroying humanity

Subscribe to our channel for more explainer videos about the Bible: https://www.youtube.com/@bibleproject

Visit our website for more resources to experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus: https://bibleproject.com/

playlists.title: Help from the Bible for Managing and Resolving Conflict
playlists.description:
Conflict is inevitable in relationships—where there are people, there will be strife. Watch this playlist to discover God’s wisdom for navigating challenges and restoring peace when relationships are difficult.

In this playlist, you’ll learn…

* Wisdom underneath covenant laws given to ancient Israel
* What the beatitudes say about peacemaking
* What the biblical word for “peace” means
* Jesus’ redefinition of power

Subscribe to our channel for more explainer videos about the Bible: https://www.youtube.com/@bibleproject

Visit our website for more resources to experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus: https://bibleproject.com/

playlists.title: How to Love Your Enemies in the Way of Jesus
playlists.description: What does the Bible say about loving your enemies? In this playlist, we take a closer look at biblical words and themes that model the way of Jesus.

playlists.title: How to Read the Bible
playlists.description: This series explores the origins, content, and purpose of the Bible. Here you'll be introduced to some of the basic skills necessary for reading the bible effectively.

playlists.title: Jesus’ Most Famous Teachings Explained
playlists.description:
Jesus’ most well-known words have shaped the lives of billions of people throughout history. The Sermon on the Mount is only three chapters long, but its ideas and images have endured throughout time. Watch this playlist to explore this carefully-designed section of Scripture.

In this playlist, you’ll learn…

* What is means for God’s Kingdom to come on Earth
* Who Jesus claimed the Kingdom of God starts with
* How we can know what it means to do right by everyone
* Why Jesus connected anger with murder and lust with adultery
* Jesus wisdom for making peace in relationships
* and more…

playlists.description: What does it mean for Jesus to be Messiah? In this playlist, we explore how the theme of the "anointed one" develops alongside the hope of a snake-crushing image of God.

playlists.title: Learn How the Tabernacle Design Fits Into the Story of the Bible
playlists.description: Why should you care about Old Testament furniture? In this playlist, we unpack the rich theme of God's presence here on earth and our role as priests. The rabbit hole goes deep. Let's dive in!

Join us as we dive into the Bible’s wisdom literature books, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, and Job. Explore biblical wisdom that shows us how to live well in God’s world.

In this playlist, you’ll learn…

playlists.description: Cette série revient sur les origines, le contenu et le dessein de la Bible. Vous y découvrirez des clés fondamentales pour mieux comprendre la Bible en la lisant selon son contexte.

playlists.title: L’Avent - La série
playlists.description: Pendant la période de l’Avent, les chrétiens ont pour habitude de méditer sur la paix, la joie et l’amour. Plongez dans l’étude de ces termes à travers notre série sur l’Avent.

fr.title: Les 10 Commandements

playlists.title: Les Êtres spirituels - La série
playlists.description: Si les anges, démons et autres êtres spirituels de la Bible vous ont déjà rendus perplexes, alors vous n’êtes pas seuls ! Nos représentations modernes de ces créatures sont fondées surtout sur des incompréhensions autant sur leur identité que sur leur place dans l’ensemble du récit biblique.

playlists.description: Approfondissez votre connaissance des « termes négatifs » de la Bible, notamment le péché, l’iniquité, et la transgression.

playlists.description: Faites une immersion dans Luc-Actes, cette œuvre en deux parties, et bénéficiez d’une perspective unique sur la vie de Jésus et celle des premiers chrétiens.

playlists.title: Panoramas: Ancien Testament
playlists.description: Notre souhait est que vous lisiez la Bible sans être déroutés, et sans jamais y renoncer. Nous avons donc produit des vidéos pour chaque livre de la Bible. Chaque vidéo ressort la structure et la conception du livre correspondant, en soulignant comment il s’intègre à l’ensemble du récit biblique.

playlists.title: Panoramas: Nouveau Testament

playlists.title: Sagesse - La série
playlists.description: Sondez le but, la portée, et la pertinence des textes de sagesse de l’Ancien Testament à travers les livres des Proverbes, de l’Ecclésiaste, et de Job, pour ensuite réapprendre le fait de vivre une belle vie.

playlists.title: Shema - La série
playlists.description: Très répandue dans la communauté Juive, le Shema est une prière qui résume le plus grand commandement de Dieu à son peuple. Faites une étude des mots du Shema pour approfondir votre compréhension de ces termes et du message qu’ils véhiculent.

videos.title: "Christ" Is Not a Name • The Anointed Ep. 1
videos.description: The title most often applied to Jesus is “the anointed one”—that’s what the Greek word “christ” means! But what is the practice of anointing? What does it signify, and who gets anointed? The practice of anointing people with oil is a theme we can trace throughout the entire story of the Bible. In this episode, Tim and Jon start a brand new theme study all about anointing.

videos.title: “Do Not Take God’s Name in Vain” Is Not About Swearing
videos.description:
Is the 3rd Commandment, “You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain,” about swearing? When God gives this command to Moses at Mount Sinai, he’s calling Israel to fulfill their purpose to carry his name faithfully.

Watch this video and explore the meaning behind this command and its significance for us today.

In this video, you will learn …

The meaning of the Hebrew word for “take” (nasa’)
What it means for God to attach his name to others
The meaning of the Hebrew word for “in vain” (shav’)
What it means to carry the name of Yahweh faithfully

00:00 The meaning of “nasa’”
01:01 God attaches his name
02:27 The meaning of “in vain” (shav’)
02:58 Carrying the name faithfully

videos.title: 3 Ways to Choose to Live in "Babylon" (and Which Jesus Chose)
videos.description:
If followers of Jesus are to give their total allegiance to God’s Kingdom, how should they relate to the governments and power structures of their own day? In this video, we’ll see how the experience of Daniel and his friends in Babylonian exile offers wisdom for navigating this tension. Following Jesus in the 21st century means learning the way of the exile.

videos.title: An Overview of Luke • Luke-Acts Ep. 2
videos.description:
Following up on part one of their discussion on the gospel of Luke, Tim and Jon continue to unpack the main themes of Luke’s unique account of Jesus’ life. The book of Luke makes clear that Jesus’ story is the continuation of the hope of the Hebrew Scriptures. Luke wants the reader to see how Jesus’ mission is for the outsiders, the poor, and the marginalized. As Jesus went around preaching about the Kingdom of God, he left behind people who were changed by him, and he called these people to live radically new lives of justice and peace.

Flooded Meadows by Unwritten Stories

videos.title: Book of Revelation Summary: A Complete Animated Overview (Part 1)
videos.description:
In this video, you're going to learn what the Book of Revelation is all about. Join us as we explore John's visions and you'll learn the symbolic imagery and numbers of the book; including the seven seals, seven trumpets, seven bowls, the Lion of Judah, the 144,000, the two witnesses, and more.

00:00 Summary of historical background, context and meaning
02:09 Jesus' message to the seven churches
03:44 John's vision of the throne of God
05:29 The cycle of the seven seals
08:22 The cycle of seven trumpets and the unsealed scroll

John makes it clear that the Book of Revelation is both an "apocalypse" (revelation) and a "prophecy." This type of Jewish literature recounted a prophet's symbolic visions that revealed God's heavenly perspective on history, so that the present could be viewed in light of history's final outcome. It was meant to comfort and/or challenge God's people. 

John says he was exiled on the island of Patmos, where he saw a vision of the risen Jesus standing among seven burning lights. The image, adapted from Zechariah 4, is a symbol of seven churches in Asia Minor. Jesus addressed the specific problems facing each church, and warned them that a "tribulation" was upon the churches that would force them to choose between compromise and faithfulness. In the midst of persecution, Jesus calls the churches to faithfulness.

The word often translated as "childbirth" or "childbearing" (Heb. "herayon") in Genesis 3:16 is explicitly not the word for "labor" or "childbirth.” How does this shift our understanding of the consequences of humanity's choice in the garden? Join Dr. Tim Mackie and students as they practice their biblical interpretation skills in the Adam to Noah class.

fr.title: Étude lexicale: YHWH - "L'Éternel"
fr.description: Le second volet de notre série d'études lexicales est une exploration en six parties de l'ancienne prière biblique appelée "Le Shema" (que l'on trouve dans Deutéronome 6:4-6). Pendant des milliers d'années, les Juifs ont prié quotidiennement ces mots qui résument l'appel de la Bible à la fidélité et la dévotion à Dieu. Nous explorerons tous les mots clés de cette prière, ainsi que ce qu'ils signifient dans leurs langue et contexte historique d'origine.

Spektu nian duan epizodon de la sesparta studo pri la antikva biblia preĝo „Ŝema Jisrael”.

Po tisíce let se Židé modlili tato slova, která shrnují biblickou výzvu k věrnosti a oddanosti vůči Bohu. V těchto videích se budeme zabývat všemi klíčovými slovy této modlitby a tím, co v originálním jazyce a v historickém kontextu znamenala.

videos.title: God's Plan to Bless Israel In Spite of Their Failure • Deuteronomy Ep. 8
videos.description:
Moses expected Israel to fail. But God's plan to bless them would not be stopped. Join Tim and Jon as they continue exploring the themes of blessing and curse in the final movement of Deuteronomy.

In this episode, you'll learn …

1. How Moses gave the opposite of a motivational pep talk in his final speech to Israel
2. How God turned Israel's failure into something good that would one day unite and bless them all
3. How the curses in Deuteronomy have to do with giving Israel exactly what they want
4. Why the human heart needed to be "circumcised"
5. How the Apostle Paul picks up on the theme of the circumcision of the heart in his writings
6. How God provided a way for us to be made righteous

Browse our entire channel for more podcast episodes and animated videos that help people experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus.

en.title: God's Plan to Bless Israel In Spite of Their Failure • Deuteronomy Ep. 8
en.description:
Moses expected Israel to fail. But God's plan to bless them would not be stopped. Join Tim and Jon as they continue exploring the themes of blessing and curse in the final movement of Deuteronomy.

In this episode, you'll learn …

1. How Moses gave the opposite of a motivational pep talk in his final speech to Israel
2. How God turned Israel's failure into something good that would one day unite and bless them all
3. How the curses in Deuteronomy have to do with giving Israel exactly what they want
4. Why the human heart needed to be "circumcised"
5. How the Apostle Paul picks up on the theme of the circumcision of the heart in his writings
6. How God provided a way for us to be made righteous

Browse our entire channel for more podcast episodes and animated videos that help people experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus.

videos.title: God's Plan to Establish His Kingdom on Earth • Gospel of the Kingdom Ep. 2
videos.description:
The Bible tells us that God’s Kingdom arrived on Earth through Jesus. But the full extent of that Kingdom has not yet come. What went wrong with the establishment of God’s Kingdom, and how does he plan to fix it? Join Tim and Jon as they continue their conversation around the theme of the Kingdom of God. 
In this episode, you'll learn …
What it means for Jesus to have authority over Heaven and Earth
How humans are invited to co-rule with Jesus now and in the future
How God responds to humans setting up their own kingdoms
Browse our entire channel for more podcast episodes and animated videos that help people experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus.

videos.title: God's Response to Human Power Structures • Firstborn Ep. 1
videos.description: In ancient Near Eastern societies, firstborn sons were prized above all other children and inherited special privileges and authority simply because of their birth order. In this episode, Tim and Jon start a new theme study covering the theme of the firstborn. Spoiler alert: The God of the Bible opposes lots of human ideas about power, and the privilege of the firstborn is no exception. Again and again, we’ll see Yahweh picking younger siblings and people we wouldn’t expect to be his chosen representatives.

videos.title: Good News for the Poor • Luke-Acts Ep. 3
videos.description:
In this episode, Tim and Jon discuss the first six chapters of the gospel of Luke. Luke stands out among the other gospels because it is all about Jesus’ message being first for the poor and outcasts. This made the religious leaders of the day mad, and Jesus’ ministry was totally revolutionary in a culture that was all about status and wealth. Luke’s gospel is constantly calling back to the Hebrew Scriptures, and it emphasizes, again and again, that Jesus is the Messiah that the prophets talked about.

Show Music
Defender Instrumental by TENTS
Blue Skies by Unwritten Stories
Flooded Meadows by Unwritten Stories

videos.title: Gospel
videos.description:
“Gospel” is one of the most common words in a Christian’s vocabulary. But what does it mean in the original languages of the Bible? In this video, we’ll discover that “gospel” is a royal announcement about Jesus, who is the crucified and risen King of the world who overcame death with his love.

0:00 What the word gospel means in the Bible
0:41 The gospel in the Old Testament
1:27 Jesus' gospel of God's kingdom
2:51 Jesus' followers spread the gospel

videos.title: How the Bible Is Unique as Literature (and Why It Matters)
videos.description:
Episode 4 explores the unique literary style of the Bible that is meant to draw its readers into a lifelong journey of reading and meditation. The Bible is designed as a multi-layered work, offering new levels of insight as you re-read it and allow each part to help you understand every other part. The Bible is the original meditation literature.

#Bible #BibleProject #BibleVideo

fr.title: La Littérature Juive de Méditation dans la Bible
fr.description:
Voici le 4ème épisode d'une série de vidéos en cours: "Comment lire la Bible". Cette série explore les origines, le contenu, et l'objectif de la Bible. Pour la lire avec sagesse, il est important de connaître les anciens styles littéraires utilisés par les  auteurs bibliques. La Bible est un livre dense qui peut être difficile à lire parfois.
Et si les paramètres qui la rendent si difficile à lire étaient en fait des invitations à une vie de méditation? 
Dans cette vidéo nous verrons en quoi la Bible représente, à l'origine, cette littérature de méditation.

pt.title: Os Profetas
pt.description: Os livros dos profetas do Antigo Testamento são cheios de densa poesia e imagens estranhas. Se você já tentou lê-los, pode ser que você tenha ficado  intrigado e confuso. Neste vídeo, nós vamos aprender como esses livros contribuem para o enredo bíblico e por que vale a pena aprender como lê-los mais atentamente.

ro.title: Profeții
ro.description: Cărțile profeților Vechiului Testament sunt pline de poezie densă și imagini stranii. Dacă ai încercat să le citești, sunt mari șanse să fi fost atât intrigat, cât și derutat. În acest clip, vom vedea cum contribuie aceste cărți la narațiunea Bibliei și de ce merită să învățăm cum să le citim cu mai mare atenție.

sl.title: Kako brati Sveto pismo: Preroki
sl.description:
Starozavezne preroške knjige so nabite z zgoščeno poezijo in divjimi prispodobami. Če ste jih poskusili brati, je precej verjetno, da ste bili hkrati očarani in zmedeni. V tem videu bomo ugotovili, kako te knjige prispevajo k poteku zgodbe celotnega Svetega pisma in zakaj se je vredno naučiti, kako jih bolj pozorno brati.
 
Prevod podnapisov v slovenščino: Svetopisemska družba Slovenije.

#Preroki #ProjektSvetopismo #SvetopismoVideo

en.title: How to Read the 15 Prophetic Books in the Bible
en.description:
The books of the Old Testament prophets are packed with dense poetry and wild imagery. If you’ve tried to read them, odds are you were both intrigued and confused. In this video, we’ll learn how these prophetic books contribute to the storyline of the Bible and why it’s worth learning how to read them more attentively.

#Prophets #BibleProject #BibleVideo

th.description: หนังสือหมวดผู้เผยพระวจนะในพันธสัญญาเดิม ถูกอัดแน่นไว้ด้วยกวีนิพนธ์และคำอุปมาแปลกตามากมาย ถ้าลองอ่านดู คุณอาจจะรู้สึกทั้งสงสัยและสับสน ในวิดีโอนี้ เราจะมาดูกันว่าหนังสือหมวดผู้เผยพระวจนะนั้น ส่งเสริมและสอดคล้องกับโครงเรื่องของพระคัมภีร์อย่างไร ทำไมเราควรศึกษา แล้วเราจะอ่านด้วยความตั้งอกตั้งใจมากขึ้นได้อย่างไร

videos.title: How to Read the Bible: Apocalyptic Literature
videos.description:
It’s the apocalypse! But what exactly does that mean? The Bible is filled with dreams and visions about human history coming to a climax, and they’re usually packed with intense imagery and strange symbols. In this video, we’ll explore the meaning of the word “apocalypse” in the Bible, and we’ll learn some basic steps for reading this literature with more wisdom and insight.

For more information, check out the following resources:
Apocalyptic Literature Question and Response video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c3_XU_BDbD0
Blog: https://tbp.xyz/apocalypseblog
Podcast: https://tbp.xyz/apocalypticpod
Script Reference Guide: https://tbp.xyz/apocalypticsrg
Video notes: https://tbp.xyz/apocalypticvn

#Apocalypse #BibleProject #Apocalyptic

sl.title: Apokalipsa
sl.description:
To je apokalipsa! Ampak kaj točno pa to pomeni? Sveto pismo je polno sanj in videnj o človeški zgodovini, ki se bliža vrhuncu. Običajno so nabita z močnimi podobami in čudnimi simboli. V tem videu bomo raziskali, kakšen pomen ima beseda »apokalipsa« v Svetem pismu. Naučili se bomo tudi osnovnih korakov, da bomo to vrsto literature brali z več modrosti in razumevanja.

Za več informacij poiščite naslednje vire:

videos.title: How to Spot Religious Hypocrisy in Yourself
videos.description:
Join us for the sixth episode exploring the most well-known collection of Jesus’ teachings, the Sermon on the Mount. In this video, you’ll learn:

- Why Jesus warns about showing your devotion to God publicly
- What Jesus meant when he called people hypocrites
- How to check your motives for giving, praying, and fasting

videos.title: How Truth Telling (and Public Lies) Can Affect a Group of People
videos.description:
What does it mean to “bear false witness” in the Bible, and why is it included in the 10 Commandments? Watch and explore the wisdom of the 9th Commandment.

In this video, you will learn …

The meaning of ‘anah, the Hebrew word used in the phrase “bear witness”
The meaning of sheqer, the Hebrew word for “false”
What it meant to “bear false witness” in ancient Israel
How both truth-telling and public lies impact a community
How this command ties in with Israel’s story

00:00 The meaning of ta ‘aneh
00:52 The meaning of sheqer
01:31 What bearing false witness is about
02:42 Communal consequences
03:32 Israel’s story
04:11 The value behind the command

View these related videos …

- மரணத்திலிருந்து உண்மையிலேயே மீட்பது எப்படி

videos.title: Jesus the Royal Priest
videos.description:
After humanity’s failure as the royal priests of Eden, God promises that one of their descendants will intervene on their behalf to restore the blessings of Eden. Throughout Israel’s story, God raises up leaders to be this royal priest, but they all fall short. But their stories point forward to the ultimate royal priest, Jesus. In this video, we’ll explore how Jesus is the ultimate king and priest who invites humans back into Eden so that we can once again take up our calling as God’s royal priests.

#BibleProject #Jesus #Priest

videos.title: Jesus' Method of Interpreting Israel's Laws • Deuteronomy Ep. 6
videos.description:
Jesus used the laws in Deuteronomy as a starting point in teaching God's ideal way of life for humanity, but he didn't stop there. Join Tim and Jon as they conclude their discussion on the law in the second movement of Deuteronomy by exploring Jesus’ understanding of the law and how it can help us interpret the Torah.

In this episode, you'll learn …
Why Israel's laws sometimes don't seem to line up with Jesus' teaching 
What Jesus thought about three challenging laws in the Torah
Why God had to give Israel the law
What to do when you encounter texts in the Bible that are difficult to understand or accept

videos.title: Metaphor in Biblical Poetry
videos.description:
Understanding how metaphors are used in the Bible is an essential tool for reading biblical poetry. Anytime someone describes one thing to describe another thing, they are using metaphorical thinking whether they realize it or not. Metaphors are everywhere in the Bible and in our everyday speech. In this video, we’ll explore this crucial aspect of biblical language.

#Metaphor #BibleProject #Metaphor

pt-BR.title: Metáfora na Poesia Bíblica
pt-BR.description:
Entender como as metáforas são usadas na Bíblia é uma ferramenta essencial para a leitura da poesia bíblica. Sempre que alguém descreve uma coisa para descrever outra, está usando o pensamento metafórico, quer perceba ou não. As metáforas estão por toda parte na Bíblia e em nossa fala cotidiana. Neste vídeo, exploraremos esse aspecto crucial da linguagem bíblica.

#Metáfora #ProjetoBíblico #Metáfora

pt.title: O Uso de Metáfora na Poesia Bíblica
pt.description: Entender como metáforas são usadas na Bíblia é uma ferramenta essencial para a leitura da poesia bíblica. Sempre que o autor cita uma coisa para descrever outra, ele está usando o pensamento metafórico, quer eles percebam isso ou não. Tanto a Biblia quanto nossas conversas do dia a dia estão cheias de Metáforas. Neste vídeo exploramos esse aspecto crucial da linguagem bíblica.

nl-NL.title: Metafoor in Bijbelse poëzie
nl-NL.description:
Begrijpen hoe metaforen in de Bijbel worden gebruikt, is een essentieel hulpmiddel bij het lezen van Bijbelse poëzie. Telkens wanneer iemand iets beschrijft om iets anders te beschrijven, gebruikt hij of zij metaforisch denken, of hij of zij zich dat nu realiseert of niet. Metaforen zijn alomtegenwoordig in de Bijbel en in ons dagelijks taalgebruik. In deze video onderzoeken we dit cruciale aspect van Bijbelse taal.

#Metafoor #BijbelProject #Metafoor

it.title: Metafora nella poesia biblica
it.description:
Capire come vengono usate le metafore nella Bibbia è uno strumento essenziale per leggere la poesia biblica. Ogni volta che qualcuno descrive una cosa per descriverne un'altra, sta usando il pensiero metaforico, che se ne renda conto o meno. Le metafore sono onnipresenti nella Bibbia e nel nostro linguaggio quotidiano. In questo video, esploreremo questo aspetto cruciale del linguaggio biblico.

#Metafora #BibleProject #Metafora

hi.title: बाइबिल कविता में रूपक
hi.description:
बाइबल में रूपकों का प्रयोग कैसे किया जाता है, यह समझना बाइबल की कविताओं को पढ़ने का एक ज़रूरी ज़रिया है। जब भी कोई किसी एक चीज़ का वर्णन किसी दूसरी चीज़ के लिए करता है, तो वह रूपकात्मक सोच का इस्तेमाल कर रहा होता है, चाहे उसे इसका एहसास हो या न हो। रूपक बाइबल में और हमारी रोज़मर्रा की बातचीत में हर जगह मौजूद हैं। इस वीडियो में, हम बाइबल की भाषा के इस महत्वपूर्ण पहलू पर चर्चा करेंगे।

#रूपक #बाइबलपरियोजना #रूपक

pl.title: Metafora w poezji biblijnej
pl.description:
Zrozumienie, jak metafory są używane w Biblii, jest niezbędnym narzędziem do czytania poezji biblijnej. Za każdym razem, gdy ktoś opisuje jedną rzecz, by opisać inną, posługuje się myśleniem metaforycznym, niezależnie od tego, czy zdaje sobie z tego sprawę, czy nie. Metafory są wszechobecne w Biblii i w naszej codziennej mowie. W tym filmie przyjrzymy się temu kluczowemu aspektowi języka biblijnego.

#Metafora #ProjektBiblijny #Metafora

sl.title: Kako brati Sveto pismo: metafore v svetopisemski poeziji
sl.description:
Ključno orodje za branje svetopisemske poezije je razumevanje, kako so  metafore uporabljali svetopisemski avtorji. Kadarkoli kdo opisuje eno stvar, da z njo opiše neko drugo stvar, razmišlja metaforično – pa če se tega zaveda ali ne. Na metafore naletimo povsod v Svetem pismu in vsakdanjem jeziku. V tem videu bomo raziskali ta ključni vidik svetopisemskega jezika.

Prevod podnapisov v slovenščino: Svetopisemska družba Slovenije.

#Metafora #ProjektSvetopismo #SvetopismoVideo

ko.title: 성경 시의 은유
ko.description:
성경에서 은유가 어떻게 사용되는지 이해하는 것은 성경 시를 읽는 데 필수적인 도구입니다. 누군가 어떤 것을 묘사하기 위해 다른 것을 묘사할 때마다, 그들은 스스로 인지하든 못하든 은유적 사고를 사용하고 있는 것입니다. 은유는 성경 곳곳에, 그리고 우리의 일상 대화 속에도 존재합니다. 이 영상에서는 성경 언어의 이 중요한 측면을 살펴보겠습니다.

#은유 #성경프로젝트 #은유

id.title: Metafora dalam Puisi Alkitab
id.description:
Memahami bagaimana metafora digunakan dalam Alkitab merupakan alat penting untuk membaca puisi Alkitab. Setiap kali seseorang menggambarkan suatu hal untuk menggambarkan hal lain, disadari atau tidak, mereka sedang menggunakan pemikiran metaforis. Metafora ada di mana-mana dalam Alkitab dan dalam percakapan kita sehari-hari. Dalam video ini, kita akan mengeksplorasi aspek penting dari bahasa Alkitab ini.

#Metafora #BibleProject #Metafora

de-DE.title: Metapher in der biblischen Poesie
de-DE.description:
Das Verständnis der Verwendung von Metaphern in der Bibel ist ein wichtiges Werkzeug für die Lektüre biblischer Poesie. Immer wenn jemand etwas beschreibt, um etwas anderes zu beschreiben, verwendet er metaphorisches Denken, ob bewusst oder unbewusst. Metaphern sind allgegenwärtig in der Bibel und in unserer Alltagssprache. In diesem Video erkunden wir diesen wichtigen Aspekt der biblischen Sprache.

#Metapher #Bibelprojekt #Metapher

ja.title: 聖書詩における比喩
ja.description:
聖書における比喩の用法を理解することは、聖書詩を読む上で不可欠なツールです。ある物事を別の物事を説明するために表現する人は、意識しているかどうかにかかわらず、比喩的な思考を用いています。比喩は聖書のいたるところ、そして私たちの日常会話の中にも見られます。このビデオでは、聖書言語におけるこの重要な側面を探ります。

#Metaphor #BibleProject #Metaphor

videos.title: Moses and Aaron
videos.description:
After God appoints Moses to confront Pharaoh and lead the Israelites out of slavery, they come to Mount Sinai, where God invites them to become “a kingdom of priests.” But things do not go as planned for the Israelites. In this video, we explore the beginning of the failed priesthood and the need for the ultimate royal priest, who will intercede on behalf of his people and offer his life for the failures of others.

videos.title: New Testament Letters: Historical Context
videos.description:
In the New Testament, there are 21 letters or epistles written by early Christian leaders to communities of Jesus' followers in the ancient Roman world. A wise reading of these letters involves learning about their historical context. Who were the letters written to, where did the recipients live, and what prompted sending the letter? In this video, we explore the different layers of historical context with these letters, so that we can better understand the wisdom they still have to offer. 

#BibleProject #Epistle #NewTestament

sl.title: Novozavezna pisma: zgodovinski kontekst
sl.description:
V Novi zavezi je 21 pisem ali poslanic, ki so jih zgodnjekrščanski voditelji napisali skupnostim Jezusovih privržencev v antičnem rimskem svetu. Pametno branje teh pisem vključuje spoznavanje njihovega zgodovinskega konteksta. Komu so bila napisana pisma, kje so prejemniki živeli in kaj je spodbudilo pošiljanje pisma? V tem posnetku raziskujemo različne ravni zgodovinskega konteksta v teh pismih, da bomo lažje razumeli modrost, ki nam jo še lahko ponudijo. 

#BibleProject #SvetoPismo #NovaZaveza

videos.title: New Testament Letters: Literary Context
videos.description:
In the New Testament, there are 21 letters written by early Christian leaders to communities of Jesus' followers in the ancient Roman world. These letters are rich with theology and guidance for what it means to be a community of Jesus followers, but they can also be dense and hard to understand. In this video we’ll explore the literary style of ancient letter writing and show you how to trace the core ideas from a letter’s beginning all the way to its end. 

#BibleProject #BibleVideo #Epistles

Ta pisma vsebujejo bogato teologijo in nas usmerjajo pri tem, kaj pomeni biti skupnost Jezusovih učencev. Vendar pa so lahko tudi zahtevna in težko razumljiva. V tem posnetku raziskujemo literarni slog pisanja pisem v antiki in vam pokažemo, kako slediti temeljni misli od začetka do konca pisma.

Prevod podnapisov v slovenščino: Svetopisemska družba Slovenije, Tomaž Maras.

videos.title: Plot in Biblical Narrative
videos.description:
An important part of reading biblical narratives is learning how to understand the nature of "the plot," how stories are arranged into a pattern of conflict and resolution. In this video we'll see how ignoring the sequence of the plot can lead to a distorted interpretation of biblical stories. We'll also explore how grasping the multi-layered nature of the narrative can help you see the unified story that leads to Jesus.

#Bible #BibleProject #BibleVideo

sl.title: Kako brato Sveto pismo: Zgradba zgodbe
sl.description:
Pri branju svetopisemskih zgodb je pomembno, da se učimo, kako razumeti naravo njihove »zgradbe«: kako so zgodbe urejene po vzorcu konflikt – razplet. V tem videu bomo spoznali, kako neupoštevanje širše zgradbe lahko pripelje do napačnega razumevanja svetopisemskih zgodb. Raziskali bomo tudi, kako nam razumevanje večplastne narave zgodb lahko pomaga, da vidimo enotno zgodbo, ki vodi k Jezusu.

en.title: Plot in Biblical Narrative
en.description:
An important part of reading biblical narratives is learning how to understand the nature of "the plot," how stories are arranged into a pattern of conflict and resolution. In this video we'll see how ignoring the sequence of the plot can lead to a distorted interpretation of biblical stories. We'll also explore how grasping the multi-layered nature of the narrative can help you see the unified story that leads to Jesus.

videos.title: Proverbs • Wisdom Ep. 2
videos.description: In this episode, Tim and Jon talk about the ancient wisdom found in the book of Proverbs. The author of Proverbs is this incredible teacher who offers guidance for just about everything humans will encounter in their lives, but is it just a book of wisdom sayings that we can memorize and put on our walls? The guys will go on to explain that wisdom, and the Hebrew concept of “chokmah,” is much more than that.

videos.title: Proverbs 8
videos.description:
In the story of the Bible, God appoints humans as his representatives in ruling the world. But once humans choose folly and death, how can they get back on track? Enter Proverbs 8, where God’s wisdom is depicted as an elegant woman who summons all people to learn her ways and find life. In this video, we explore this remarkable poem that forces us all to make a choice: whose wisdom will we choose to live by?

videos.title: Psalm 148
videos.description:
Psalm 148 is a call for the whole cosmos to praise God. In the climactic conclusion of Psalm 148, we read that Israel should praise God because he has raised a horn for them. But what’s the deal with this horn? And why is God lifting it up? In this video, we explore how Psalm 148 fits into the overall story of the book of Psalms—the story of God’s promise to raise up a king who will bring victory to Israel and rescue the world.

videos.title: Rivalry Among Brothers • Firstborn Ep. 3
videos.description: Only a few pages into the story of the Bible, the story starts to get really bleak. Cain kills his brother Abel, Cain’s descendants become famous murderers, and Noah’s youngest son violates his father and mother. And all of it happens because humans decide that power is worth the cost of harming others. In this episode, Tim and Jon discuss the dark side of human nature and the God who favors the powerless—the people who choose to trust him for blessing and exaltation.

videos.title: SABBATH: Learn Why the Number 7 Is Used So Much in the Bible
videos.description:
On page one of the Bible, God orders a beautiful world out of chaotic darkness within a sequence of six days. And on the seventh day, God rests. This introduces the major biblical theme of patterns of seven that conclude with God and humans resting together as partners. In this video, we explore the theme of seventh day rest and the biblical concept of Sabbath. We also look at why Jesus adopted this idea as a major part of his own mission to bring God's Kingdom to earth.

Explore Sabbath page here: https://tbp.xyz/exploresabbath
Sabbath podcast series here: https://tbp.xyz/sabbathpodcast

Pogledamo tudi, zakaj je Jezus to idejo sprejel kot pomemben del lastnega poslanstva, da prinese Božje kraljestvo na zemljo.

el.title: Σάββατο
el.description:
Στην πρώτη σελίδα της Βίβλου, ο Θεός δημιουργεί έναν όμορφο κόσμο, βάζοντας τάξη στο χαοτικό σκοτάδι, σ' ένα διάστημα έξι ημερών. Και την έβδομη ημέρα ο Θεός αναπαύεται. Αυτή είναι η εισαγωγή σε ένα κύριο Βιβλικό θέμα, από επαναλαμβανόμενα εφτάρια, που καταλήγουν με τον Θεό και τους ανθρώπους να αναπαύονται μαζί ως συνέταιροι. Σε αυτό το βίντεο, εξερευνούμε το θέμα της ανάπαυσης της έβδομης ημέρας και της Βιβλικής ιδέας του Σαββάτου. Επίσης κοιτάμε το γιατί ο Ιησούς υιοθέτησε αυτή την ιδέα ως ένα κύριο μέρος της δικής του αποστολής να φέρει τη Βασιλεία του Θεού στη γη.

Εξερευνήστε τη σελίδα του Σαββάτου εδώ: https://tbp.xyz/exploresabbath

videos.title: Seizing vs. Receiving Power • Firstborn Ep. 2
videos.description: It’s not explicitly stated, but the theme of the firstborn first appears in the opening narratives of the Hebrew Bible. In Genesis 1 and 2, Yahweh elevates humans, the latecomers of creation, to rule the land. In Genesis 3, a snake, who is some kind of spiritual being, tricks the humans despite their authority as God’s image bearers. This story is echoed in other accounts of sibling rivalry that continue throughout the Hebrew Bible. Join Tim and Jon as they discuss the land rulers and sky rulers and the theme of the firstborn in Genesis 1-3.

videos.title: Setting in Biblical Narrative
videos.description:
Every story has to take place somewhere, and very often locations have a special meaning or significance evoked by events that already took place there. In this video, we explore how biblical authors use settings in the narrative to meet the reader's expectations or mess with them. Paying attention to locations and time in biblical stories unlocks deeper layers of meaning.

#Bible #BibleProject #BibleVideo

sl.title: Kako brati Sveto pismo: prizorišče
sl.description:

V tem videu raziščemo, kako svetopisemski avtorji v pripovedih uporabljajo prizorišča in tako včasih izpolnijo pričakovanja bralca, včasih pa se z njimi poigrajo. Če smo pozorni na kraj in čas v svetopisemskih zgodbah, bomo spoznali še globlje plasti pomena.

Prevod podnapisov v slovenščino: Svetopisemska družba Slovenije.

fi.title: Shema - "Kuulla" (Word Study)

videos.title: The "Teacher" vs. Jesus • Wisdom Ep. 4
videos.description: Hanging out with Ecclesiastes isn’t fun. The book goes on about the endless march of time that results in death for everyone. Everything dies––humans and animals. We can see that all living creatures go to the dirt, and we don’t have any concrete proof of what happens after that. Depressing, right? Yes––it can be. The teacher is trying to shake things up and dismantle the illusions of the reader, but it can be rough to read. The guys will talk about the context of Ecclesiastes, and why we as Jesus followers can see things differently.

videos.description:
David’s life gives us two parallel portrayals of what it means to be God’s anointed one: one is victorious—God’s anointed is the giant feller and the snake crusher. The other one is a suffering servant, waiting patiently in the wilderness for God’s deliverance. In today’s episode, join Tim and Jon in the Psalms, where they’ll explore both David’s victory and his suffering and discuss how Jesus saw himself living out both those roles too.

David’s life gives us two parallel portrayals of what it means to be God’s anointed one: one is victorious—God’s anointed is the giant feller and the snake crusher. The other one is a suffering servant, waiting patiently in the wilderness for God’s deliverance. In today’s episode, join Tim and Jon in the Psalms, where they’ll explore both David’s victory and his suffering and discuss how Jesus saw himself living out both those roles too.

pt.title: Evangelho de Lucas Caps. 19-23
pt.description: A última semana da vida de Jesus culminou em uma semana controversa em Jerusalém durante a Festa da Páscoa. Neste vídeo, nós exploraremos o Evangelho de Lucas caps. 19-23, e como que Jesus, que era inocente, acabou sendo executado como um rebelde revolucionário contra Roma. Veremos também como Jesus não foi surpreendido, porque Ele acreditava que sua morte iniciaria um novo futuro para Israel e para toda a humanidade.

id.title: Injil Lukas Pasal 19-23
id.description: Minggu terakhir kehidupan Yesus memuncak dalam suatu minggu yang kontroversial di Yerusalem selama masa Paskah. Dalam video ini kita akan menjelajahi Injil Lukas pasal. 19-23, dan bagaimana kejadian bahwa Yesus yang tidak bersalah pada akhirnya dieksekusi sebagai seorang pemberontak revolusioner yang melawan Romawi. Kita juga akan melihat bagaimana Yesus sama sekali tidak terkejut, karena Ia percaya bahwa kematianNya akan membuka masa depan yang baru bagi Israel, dan bagi semua umat manusia.

sl.title: Evangelij po Luku pogl. 19-23

Videli bomo tudi, da Jezus nad tem sploh ni bil presenečen, ker je verjel, da bo njegova smrt omogočila novo prihodnost za Izrael in za vse človeštvo.

pl.title: Ewangelia św. Łukasza: rozdziały 19-23

Zobaczymy też, że Jezus nie był tym w ogóle zaskoczony, bo wierzył, że jego śmierć otworzy nową przyszłość dla Izraela i całej ludzkości.

videos.title: The Disturbing But Surprising Wisdom of Ecclesiastes
videos.description:
In Ecclesiastes, we hear the skeptical voice of “the teacher.” He observes that living by the book of Proverbs doesn’t always bring positive results. Sometimes life is hard and defies neat explanations. How do you live with that tension, and still strive for wisdom? Ecclesiastes is the second of the three biblical wisdom books.

03:18 Life is like smoke

05:00 The proper response to the meaning of Ecclesiastes

videos.title: The Garden Was Not Perfect • Image of God Ep. 3
videos.description: In this episode, Tim and Jon wrap up their discussion on the image of God. Scripture tells us that humans are made in the image of God, but what does that actually mean for our lives? Do we exist simply to glorify God, or does bearing the image of God mean we have a greater responsibility? As Christians, we tend to think we have to divide secular and sacred, but as the guys will unpack, this doesn’t have to be the case and we can choose to reflect God and his image in all that we do.

In Genesis, God makes a good world and installs humans as its rulers. God’s response is to set in motion a plan to rescue and bless the whole world through the family of Abraham.

es.title: El Evangelio de Lucas Caps. 9-19
es.description:
En este vídeo exploramos la parte central del Evangelio de Lucas que cuenta el largo viaje de Jesús hacia Jerusalén. Él continua su polémico anuncio de las buenas noticias para los pobres, lo cuál incrementa el conflicto con los líderes religiosos de Israel. La tensión provee el escenario para la famosa parábola del Hijo Pródigo en la cuál Jesús resume todo lo que de Él se trata.

** Corrección de créditos: Guionistas gráficos para este vídeo son Allan Rosenow y Ryan Rosenow.

en.title: The Prodigal Son: Luke 9-19
en.description:
Part three explores the central part of Luke's Gospel. Jesus continues his controversial announcement of good news for the poor during his long road-trip to Jerusalem, which increases conflict with Israel’s religious leaders. This tension provides the setting for the famous parable of the Prodigal Son.

*Credits Correction: Storyboard artists for this video are Allan Rosenow and Ryan Rosenow.

#ProdigalSon #Jesus #BibleProject

pl.title: Ewangelia św. Łukasza: rozdziały 9-19
pl.description: W tym filmie badamy środkową część Ewangelii Łukasza, która przedstawia podróż Jezusa do Jerozolimy. Jezus kontynuuje swoje kontrowersyjne głoszenie dobrej nowiny dla biednych, co nasila jego konflikt z przywódcami religijnymi Izraela. Staje się to pretekstem do przedstawienia słynnej przypowieści o synu marnotrawnym, w której Jezus podsumowuje, o co mu chodzi.

videos.title: The Reason You Can Trust God (Even When It Seems Risky)
videos.description:
The word emet is a common word used to describe God in the Bible. It can be translated as “faithfulness” or “truth.” So when the authors say that God is “full of emet,” they are saying that he is trustworthy and faithful—we can trust him. But trusting isn’t always an easy thing. In this video, we look at why we can trust that God is full of emet. 

View more resources on God's faithful character:

- Blog: https://tbp.xyz/faithfulblog
- Podcast: https://tbp.xyz/faithfulpodcast

videos.title: The Repeating Pattern from The Exodus You May Not Have Noticed
videos.description:
The story of Israel’s exodus is a narrative theme that runs through the whole story of the Bible. But it’s not just Israel’s story—it's all of ours. Watch this video and discover the journey of the Exodus Way out of slavery, through the wilderness, and into the promised land.

In this video, you will learn:
- Characteristics of each movement of the journey
- How the exodus pattern is like a melody on repeat throughout the Bible
- The true identity of the slavery Jesus frees us from
- Why the first followers of Jesus called their movement “The Way”
- How Jesus’ followers journey in the wilderness

videos.title: The Resurrection of Jesus: Luke 24
videos.description:
This video concludes Luke's epic portrait of Jesus of Nazareth. The disciples discover the empty tomb and eventually have their entire view of the world turned upside-down as they meet the risen Jesus. Luke shows how Jesus' kingdom of God mission comes to its climactic moment, and he sets the stage for its continuation in Luke's second volume, Acts.

videos.title: The Royal Priesthood
videos.description:
After Jesus’ disciples receive the Holy Spirit, they become God’s temple and the physical embodiment of Jesus on Earth. The New Testament writers show us that followers of Jesus carry the responsibility to live as royal priests forward into eternity, reclaiming the lost calling God gave humanity to represent him and rule the world on his behalf. And the story of the Bible ends where it began: in a garden with humans serving and ruling as God’s royal priests forever.

#BibleProject #Priest #RoyalPriest

videos.title: The Satan and Demons • Understand Evil Spiritual Beings in the Bible (Spiritual Beings Series Ep 4)
videos.description:
The storyline of the Bible presents a populated spiritual world, full of creatures who are in rebellion against their Creator, just like humans. For lots of fascinating reasons, our modern conceptions of the Satan and demons are based on serious misunderstandings of the Bible. So let’s go back to the book of Genesis and start over as we learn about the powers of spiritual evil in the story of the Bible.

Link to The Satan and Demons video notes: http://bit.ly/30MK2O1
Link to The Satan and Demons Question and Response video: https://bddy.me/2KnZcUn

Special thanks to Dr. Michael S. Heiser, author of “The Unseen Realm,” for script consulting on this series.

videos.title: The Satan and Demons Question and Response - BibleProject
videos.description:
The topic of The Satan and Demons explores some of the strangest passages in the entire Bible. We gathered some of your questions after our video released and respond to them in a question and response video. Thank you for engaging with our content!

Link to our podcast: http://bit.ly/2Wl4LdG
Link to notes: https://bit.ly/2VKtfI1
The Satan and Demons video: http://bit.ly/2KrOAE2

Questions

1. (1:14) Why did God allow The Satan to live in the Garden of Eden, even if it was in rebellion against Him?

2. (5:22) What are the seraphim? Why do you call seraphim "snakes" instead of "burning ones?"

3. (13:06) Wasn't The Satan named Lucifer? Where did the name "Lucifer" come from?

4. (19:22) Why do you say "The Satan" instead of just "Satan?" Why did translators leave out the "The" when translating the Bible?

5. (24:42) When the world was created, God said it was "good." Why did you say The Satan brings creation back into chaos and death in the video?

6. (29:10) How can the sons of God have sexual relations with human women if they are spiritual beings? Do spiritual beings have reproductive organs?

7. (40:01) What are the Nephilim and where did they come from?

8. (42:47) How do humans participate in the evil we see in the world?

9. (44:47) Why did you end the video with Jesus being overtaken by evil?


#Satan #Demons #BibleProject

sr.description: Овај видео резимира целокупну причу о Библији као низ унакрсних одлука. Читаво човечанство, праћено Израелцима, редефинише добро и зло и завршава у Вавилону. Након њих следи Исус који креће другачијим путем који отвара пут ка новој креацији.

ro.title: Povestea Bibliei
ro.description: Acesta este episodul 2 al unei serii intregi numite „Cum se citește Biblia”, care exploră originile, conținutul și scopul Bibliei. În acest videoclip rezumăm povestea generală a Bibliei ca o serie de decizii la „răscruce”. Toată omenirea, urmată de israeliți, redefinește binele și răul și sfârșește în Babilon. Ei sunt urmați de Isus, care ia un drum diferit, ce deschide calea către o nouă creație.

sl.title: Zgodba Svetega pisma
sl.description: Druga epizoda povzema celotno zgodbo Svetega pisma kot vrsto prelomnih odločitev. Vse človeštvo in potem tudi Izraelci si samovoljno določijo, kaj je dobro in zlo, in tako končajo v Babilonu. Nato pride Jezus, ki gre v nasprotno smer in odpre pot k novemu stvarjenju.

af.title: Die storie van die Bybel
af.description: Hierdie is die tweede episode in 'n reeks genaamd "Hoe om die Bybel te lees", wat die oorsprong, inhoud, en doel van die Bybel ontgin. In hierdie video gee ons 'n opsomming van die algehele storie van die Bybel as 'n reeks kruispad besluite. Die hele mensdom, gevolg deur die Isrealiete, herdefiniëer goed en kwaad en beland uiteindelik in Babilon. Hulle word gevolg deur Jesus, wat 'n ander pad stap, en so die weg na 'n nuwe skepping oopmaak.

Όλη η ανθρωπότητα, στη συνέχεια και ο λαός Ισραήλ, επαναπροσδιορίζει το καλό και το κακό και καταλήγει στη Βαβυλώνα. Ακολουθεί όμως ο Ιησούς, ο οποίος παίρνει ένα διαφορετικό μονοπάτι που ανοίγει τον δρόμο για μια νέα δημιουργία.

#Βίβλος #BibleProject #BibleVideo

fi.title: Raamatun tarina
fi.description: Tämä on 2. jakso 14-osaisesta sarjasta Kuinka lukea Raamattua. Sarjassa tutkitaan Raamatun alkuperää, sisältöä ja merkitystä. Tässä videossa tiivistetään Raamatun punainen lanka sarjaksi reittivalintoja. Koko ihmiskunta ja Israelin kansa määrittelevät hyvän ja pahan uudelleen ja joutuvat Babyloniin. Sen jälkeen tulee Jeesus, joka valitsee toisen tien, joka avaa reitin uuteen luomiseen.

it.title: La Storia della Bibbia
it.description: Questo è il secondo di una serie di quattordici episodi, chiamata "Come leggere la Bibbia". Essa esplora le origini, il contenuto e lo scopo della Bibbia. In questo video riassumiamo l'intera storia della Bibbia come una serie di "incroci decisionali." Tutta l'umanità, seguita dagli israeliti, ridefinisce il bene e il male e finisce in Babilonia. Essi sono poi seguiti da Gesù, che prende un sentiero diverso che apre la via ad una nuova creazione.

ar.title: قصة الكتاب المقدس
ar.description: تلخص الحلقة الثانية قصة الكتاب المقدس في شكل سلسة من القرارات المفصلية. كل البشرية، ثم شعب إسرائيل يسيروا في طريق إعادة تعريف الخير والشر وهذا الطريق ينتهي ببابل. لكن يسوع المسيح يسري طريقًا آخر يفتح الباب لخليقة جديدة.

pt.title: A História da Bíblia
pt.description: Este é o 2º episódio de uma série de 14 partes , chamada: Como ler a Bíblia, que explora as origens, o conteúdo e propósito da Bíblia. Neste vídeo, resumimos a história geral da Bíblia como uma série de decisões cruzadas. Toda a humanidade, seguida pelos israelitas, redefiniram o bem e o mal e acabaram na Babilônia. Eles são seguidos por Jesus, que toma um caminho diferente e abre o caminho para uma nova criação.

nl.title: Het verhaal van de Bijbel
nl.description: Dit is aflevering 2 van een 14-delige serie genaamd: Hoe Lees je de Bijbel die de oorsprong, de inhoud en het doel van de Bijbel onderzoekt. In deze video vatten we het algemene verhaal van de Bijbel samen als een reeks 'kruispunt-' beslissingen. De gehele mensheid, gevolgd door de Israëlieten, ze geven een eigen betekenis aan goed en kwaad en belanden in Babylon. Ze worden gevolgd door Jezus, die een ander pad neemt en daarmee de weg naar een nieuwe schepping opent.

sv.title: Bibelns berättelse
sv.description: Det här är avsnitt 2 i en serie på 14 delar som kallas "Hur man läser Bibeln" och som utforskar ursprunget, innehållet och syftet med Bibeln. I den här videon sammanfattar vi den övergripande Bibelberättelsen som en serie beslut vid vägskäl. Hela mänskligheten, och sedan även Israeliterna, omdefinierar godhet och ondskan och hamnar i Babylon. De följs av Jesus, som tar en annan väg och öppnar upp för en ny skapelse.

videos.title: The Surprise of the City • The City Ep. 1
videos.description:
The theme of the city in the Bible is a surprising one. When cities are introduced in the story, they’re depicted as “bad”—a human response to increasing violence and the need for self-protection—and gardens are depicted as humanity’s ideal setting. However, in the book of Revelation, the new creation Jesus brings is a city. What’s going on here? Join Tim and Jon as they start exploring the biblical theme of the city.

Show Music
“Defender (Instrumental)” by TENTS
“Kokon” by Plusma & Guillaume Muschalle
“Long Lost Friend” by Sam Stewart
“Just a Thought” by Tyler Bailey

videos.title: This Hebrew Word Is Translated as “Sign”
videos.description:
Explore the Hebrew word 'ot (אֹת), meaning “sign,” and uncover its deeper meaning in this short video. In Hebrew, an 'ot is not just a symbol—it points to a greater reality while containing a piece of that reality within itself.

In this video, we’ll explore a few powerful examples:
- Noah’s rainbow, a sign of God’s everlasting promise
- Moses’ serpent-staff, representing the divine power he receives to confront Pharaoh
- The blood on the door during Passover, symbolizing the sacrifice that spared the Israelites’ firstborn

videos.title: We Studied the Temple in the Bible (Here’s What We Found)
videos.description:
In this video, we explore how Israel’s temple in the Bible is described as the place where God’s space and humanity’s space are one. In fact, the whole biblical drama can be told as a story about God’s temple. In the opening pages of Genesis, God creates a cosmic temple, and in the person of Jesus, God takes up personal residence in his temple-world. By the end of the biblical story, all of creation has become God’s sacred temple. 

#Temple #BibleProject #BibleVideo

Στην πραγματικότητα, ολόκληρο το βιβλικό δρώμενο μπορεί να ειπωθεί ως μια ιστορία για τον ναό του Θεού. Στις αρχικές σελίδες της Γένεσης, ο Θεός δημιουργεί έναν κοσμικό ναό και στο πρόσωπο του Ιησού, ο Θεός μετακομίζει προσωπικά στον κόσμο-ναό. Μέχρι το τέλος της βιβλικής ιστορίας, όλη η δημιουργία έχει γίνει ο ιερός ναός του Θεού.

In this episode, Tim and Jon try to tackle some of the glaring questions about the story of Job. They talk about the surprise friend, Elihu, who seems to show up out of nowhere towards the end of the story. They also spend some time discussing Job’s speech in chapter 28. There’s a lot to unpack in that chapter, and understanding it may give us clues as to what this book is all about. Finally the guys look at Job’s final showdown with God and how God responds to Job’s accusations of being unjust and unfair.

videos.title: What God Wanted Moses to Tell Israel Before He Died • Deuteronomy Ep. 9
videos.description:
A pivotal point in the story of the Bible is when Moses says farewell to Israel before his death in the book of Deuteronomy. Join Tim and Jon as they conclude exploring the themes of blessing and curse in the final movement of the book by looking closely at a song Moses wrote in chapter 32.

In this episode, you'll learn...

1. Yahweh predicts Israel's unfaithfulness to the covenant
2. Yahweh told Moses to write a song that would stand as a witness between God and Israel of God's prediction

videos.title: What is The Bible Project?
videos.description:
What is The Bible Project?

The Bible Project is a non-profit animation studio that produces short-form, fully animated videos to make the biblical story accessible to everyone, everywhere. We create videos, podcasts, and study guides that explore the Bible’s unified story.

The Bible is a divine-human book that speaks God’s word to his people. We believe it ultimately points us to Jesus, who has the power to change individuals and whole communities when we let the biblical story speak for itself.

We focus on the Bible's overarching themes and each book’s literary design and are committed to understanding the Bible in its historical context.

ko.title: "The Bible Project"란?
ko.description:
"The Bible Project"는 비영리적인 애니메이션 스튜디오로서 모든 사람, 모든 곳에서 성경 이야기를 볼 수 있도록 짧은 형식의 애니메이션 동영상을 제작합니다.

우리는 성경의 통일된 이야기를 탐구하는 비디오, 팟캐스트 및 스터디 가이드를 만듭니다.

성경은 하나님의 말씀을 그의 백성에게 말하는 구원받은 사람들에 대한 책입니다. 성경이 궁극적으로 가리키는 것은 개인과 공동체를 변화시킬 수있는 힘을 가진 예수님이시며, 이러한 변화는 성경이 그 스스로 우리에게 말하도록 할 때에 일어납니다. 

우리는 다양한 모든 이슈에 적용될 수 있는 성경의 중요한 주제와 성경 각 권의 문학적 디자인에 중점을두고 역사적인 맥락에서 성경을 이해하기 위해 노력합니다.

pt.title: Lev: "Coração"

У овом видеу, истражићемо древну хебрејску речи за "срце" као и различите идеје онога што наша срца представља. Не постоји библијска реч која би боље обухватила суштину људске мисли, осећања и жеље од ове богате и дивне речи.

nl.title: Lev: "Hart"
nl.description:
Verschillende culturen hebben verschillende opvattingen van het menselijk hart, wat het is en wat het doet, daarop zijn de Bijbelse schrijvers geen uitzondering. In deze video gaan we op zoek naar de oude Hebreeuwse woorden voor "hart", en ook naar wat onze harten voorstellen. Er is geen 
Bijbels woord dat de betekenis van menselijke gedachten, gevoelens en verlangens beter beschrijft, dan dit rijke en prachtige woord.

videos.title: What It Means to Love God With "All Your Soul"
videos.description:
We explore the Hebrew word "nephesh" that often gets translated as "soul." The English word usually refers to a non-material essence of a human that survives after death, but nephesh means something different. It is referring to humans as living, breathing, physical beings, or just to life itself. Prepare to be surprised at the biblical meaning of this fascinating word.

#Soul #BibleProject #Shema

sr.title: Изучавање речи: Нефеш - "Душа"
sr.description: Истражујемо јеврејску реч "нефеш" која се често преводи као "душа". Енглеска реч обично се односи на нематеријалну суштину човека која преживи после смрти, али нефеш значи нешто друго. То се односи на људе као живот, дисање, физичка бића или само на живот. Припремите се да будете изненађени библијским значењем ове фасцинантне речи!

pt.title: Estudo da palavra: Nephesh - "Alma"
pt.description: Exploramos a palavra hebraica "nephesh" que é muitas vezes traduzida como "alma".  A palavra "alma" traduzida em nosso idioma geralmente refere a uma essência não-material do ser humano que sobrevive depois da morte, mas nephesh significa algo diferente. Refere-se aos humanos enquanto seres vivos físicos que respiram, ou simplesmente à própria vida em si. Prepare-se para ser surpreendido pelo significado bíblico desta fascinante palavra!

Pretiĝu por esti surprizita de la biblia signifo de tiu interesega vorto!

videos.title: What the Biblical Authors Meant by the Word "Earth"
videos.description:
This session is from the BibleProject Classroom class Heaven and Earth, taught by Dr. Tim Mackie. The entire class is available for free on the BibleProject app at http://classroom-beta.bibleproject.com/heaven-and-earth.

What did the biblical authors intend to communicate when they used the word "earth?" Genesis 1 is an ancient cosmology that uses specific words and images to describe the ordered world as understood by ancient people. When we study this chapter, we can discover how the writers of the Bible understood the structure of the world and its origins 

In Hebrew, the word for "earth" ('erets) typically means land rather than a globe or sphere floating in space. The raqia' is the solid dome above the land that holds back the waters above, and the creation of the raqia' creates a place where life can flourish. Dive into Genesis 1 and explore how these Hebrew words can help us see the important theological claim being made through this cosmology picture.

6. How animal sacrifices atone for sin

Browse our entire channel for more podcast episodes and animated videos that help people experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus.

videos.title: Where Is There Idolatry in Modern Culture?
videos.description:
The first chapter of Ezekiel presents readers with a question: Why is the Temple Presence of Yahweh appearing to a guy by a river in Babylon? 

This class session explores how the answer to that question begins to unfold in chapter 8. Ezekiel's "nightmare tour" presents an inversion of Eden imagery resulting from the idolatry of the people.

This chapter challenges readers to consider how we give our allegiance to things of our own creation. Start this session and explore what the vision of an ancient prophet can say to our modern world. 

Check out the full class on our website or app! https://bibleproject.com/classroom/ezekiel

videos.title: Where on Earth is Uz? • Wisdom E6
videos.description:
In this episode, Tim and Jon continue their discussion on Job. How exactly does Job fit in with the other wisdom book of the Bible? It’s kind of a weird book. Job takes place in Uz, a non-Israelite town, and it features non-Israelite people. It seems out of place, but it’s also a book that other biblical authors refer to throughout Scripture. We have to wonder about the differences between Job and the other books of the Bible. Is Job a literal account, or is it a wisdom parable that is intentionally fiction?

Show Music

Blue Skies by Unwritten Stories
Flooded Meadows by Unwritten Stories

videos.title: Why Cain Builds a City • The City Ep. 2
videos.description:
In the story of the Bible, cities are a bad thing. They’re a symptom of humanity’s violence and attempts to protect themselves instead of trusting God. In fact, in the second chapter of Genesis, God “builds” something for humanity’s protection. And it’s not a city—it’s a woman. In this episode, Tim and Jon explore the theme of the city and the first thing God builds.

“Start Me Up” by Tyler Bailey

videos.title: Why God’s Commands Are Like Blessings
videos.description:
The 10 Commandments are not simply rules—they’re an invitation. Watch this video and learn how every command in the Bible invites us to discover the wisdom of God.

In this video, you will learn…

* What the first command in the Bible is.

* Where real wisdom comes from.
* How to hear God’s voice in biblical commands.

videos.description:
If you thought “Christ” was Jesus’ last name or the title he gave himself, think again! The title Jesus most often used for himself is the "Son of Man.” In this video, we’ll explore the meaning of this fascinating phrase and see how it invites us into the larger biblical story.

#SonofMan #BibleProject #Jesus

fr.title: Fils de l'homme
fr.description: Si vous pensiez que "Christ" était le nom de famille de Jésus, ou le titre qu'il se donnait, c'est raté ! Dans cette vidéo, nous explorons la signification de cette appellation fascinante, et nous verrons comment elle nous conduit dans la grande histoire biblique.

videos.title: Why Jesus Told Parables (and How You Can Understand Them)
videos.description:
Jesus of Nazareth was a master storyteller, and many of his most well-known teachings were told as parables. But these stories were designed to do much more than simply "teach." Jesus said the parables were designed to both reveal and conceal his message about the arrival of God's Kingdom. In this video, we explore the main themes in Jesus' parables and ask why he used them as the primary vehicle for his message.

#BibleProject #Parables #Jesus

el.title: Πώς να διαβάζουμε τη Βίβλο: Οι παραβολές του Ιησού
el.description: Ο Ιησούς από τη Ναζαρέτ ήταν καταπληκτικός αφηγητής και πολλές από τις πιο γνωστές του διδασκαλίες λέγονταν ως παραβολές. Αλλά αυτές οι ιστορίες είχαν σχεδιαστεί για να κάνουν πολύ περισσότερα από απλώς να "διδάξουν". Ο Ιησούς είπε ότι οι παραβολές σχεδιάστηκαν έτσι ώστε να αποκαλύπτουν, αλλά και να κρύβουν το μήνυμά του για την άφιξη της Βασιλείας του Θεού. Σε αυτό το βίντεο, διερευνούμε τα βασικά θέματα στις παραβολές του Ιησού και αναρωτιόμαστε γιατί τις χρησιμοποίησε ως πρωταρχικό όχημα για το μήνυμά του.

sl.title: Kako brati Sveto pismo: Jezusove prilike
sl.description:
Jezus iz Nazareta je bil mojstrski pripovedovalec. Mnogo svojih najbolj znanih naukov je povedal v obliki prilik. Toda te zgodbe so narejene za dosti več kot preprosto za »pouk«. Jezus je povedal, da je namen prilik, da hkrati razkrivajo in prikrivajo njegovo sporočilo o prihodu Božjega kraljestva. V tem videu bomo raziskali glavne teme Jezusovih prilik in se vprašali, zakaj jih je uporabljal kot glavne nosilce svojega sporočila.

#Prilike #Jezus #ProjektSvetopismo #SvetopismoVideo

fi.description: "Pyhä Henki” on ilmaisu Raamatussa, jota käytetään kuvaamaan Jumalan henkilökohtaisen läsnäolon mysteeriäja voimaa. Tässä videossa tutkimme hepreankielisen henkeä ja henkäystä tarkoittavan sanan merkitystä ja sitä, miten sen ymmärtäminen voi auttaa näkemään koko Raamatun tarinan uudella tavalla.

pt.title: Espiríto Santo
pt.description: "Espirito Santo" é uma expressão usada na Bíblia para descrever o mistério e o poder da presença pessoal de Deus. Neste vídeo exploramos o que significa a palavra "espírito/respiração" do original Hebraico e como entender isso poderá ajuda-lo a ver a história da Bíblia de uma maneira totalmente nova.

nl.title: Heilige Geest
nl.description: De "Heilige Geest" is een term in de Bijbel die gebruikt wordt om het mysterie en de kracht van God's aanwezigheid te beschrijven. In deze video bekijken we de oorspronkelijke Hebreeuwse betekenis van het woord "geest/adem", en hoe het begrijpen hiervan je kan helpen de verhaallijn van de  hele Bijbel op een nieuwe manier te bekijken.

sv.title: Den Helige Ande
sv.description: "Den Helige Ande" är ett uttryck i Bibeln som används för att beskriva mysteriet och kraften av Guds personliga närvaro. I den här videon utforskar vi den ursprungliga hebreiska betydelsen av ordet "ande/andetag", och hur du genom att förstå detta kan få hjälp att se hela Bibelns berättelse på ett nytt sätt.

zh.title: 聖靈
zh.description: 「聖靈」在聖經當中是用來描述神同在的奧秘和大能的短语。在影片中，我們探討希伯來原文「靈/氣息」的意思，透過对其原意的理解，我們會對整本聖經的脈絡有更新一層的認識。

et.title: Püha Vaim
et.description: Selles videos uurime, mis on esialgne tähendus Piibli mõistele "vaim" ja mida tähendab see, et Jumala Vaim viibib isiklikult kohal kogu loodus. Lõpptulemusena on Vaim avalduv läbi Jeesuse ja on saadetud Tema jüngrite ellu, et tuua sinna uut loomist.

en.title: Why the Holy Spirit Isn’t Just a “Force”
en.description:
In this video, we explore the original meaning of the biblical concept of “spirit” and what it means that God’s Spirit is personally present in all of creation. Ultimately, the Holy Spirit was revealed through Jesus and sent out into the lives of his followers to bring about the new creation.

#HolySpirit #BibleProject #BibleVideo

sl.title: Sveti Duh
sl.description:
V tem videu raziščemo izvirni pomen svetopismskega koncepta »duha« in kaj pomeni, da je Božji Duh osebno prisoten v vsem stvarstvu. Svetega Duha je dokončno razodel Jezus, ki ga je tudi poslal v življenja svojih učencev, da bi uresničil novo stvarstvo.

#SvetDuh #ProjektSvetoPismo #BibleVideo

es.title: El Espíritu Santo
es.description: "Espíritu Santo" es una frase en la Biblia usada para describir el misterio y el poder de la presencia personal de Dios. En este video exploramos el significado original de la palabra en Hebreo para "espíritu/aliento", y cómo  entender esto puede ayudarte a ver la historia bíblica de una forma totalmente nueva.

videos.title: Why The Sabbath Is One Of The Most Important Practices In Human History
videos.description:
Why would God command his covenant people to stop working one day a week? Watch this video and explore the wisdom of rhythmic rest.

In this video, you will learn …

• The meaning of the Hebrew word for “Sabbath”
• What it means to treat the Sabbath day as holy
• Who is supposed to treat the Sabbath day as holy
• The significance of the Hebrew word for “seven”
• What’s unique about the seventh day in the Genesis 1 creation narrative
• Whether the Sabbath needs to be observed on a specific day of the week

00:00 The meaning of Shabbat (“Sabbath”)
00:30 Treating the Sabbath as holy
01:02 The significance of sheva‘ (seven)
01:24 The seventh day of creation
03:30 The day of the week for Sabbath

videos.title: Why Water Matters in the Bible
videos.description:
In the beginning of the Bible, God transforms a desolate wilderness into a garden through a stream that waters the ground and brings life wherever it goes. This image gets developed throughout the biblical story as wells, cisterns, rain, and rivers all become images of God’s creative power. In this video, we’ll explore the “water of life” theme through the biblical story and see how it leads to Jesus, who presents himself as the one bringing living water to a world that is desperately thirsty. 

#BibleProject #WaterofLife #BibleVideo

el.title: Το νερό της ζωής
el.description:
Στην αρχή της Βίβλου, ο Θεός μετατρέπει μια έρημο σε έναν κήπο μέσα από ένα ρεύμα που ποτίζει το έδαφος και φέρνει τη ζωή όπου κι αν πηγαίνει. Αυτή η εικόνα αναπτύσσεται σε όλη τη βιβλική ιστορία, καθώς και πηγάδια, δεξαμενές, βροχή και ποτάμια, όλα γίνονται εικόνες της δημιουργικής δύναμης του Θεού. Σε αυτό το βίντεο, θα διερευνήσουμε το «νερό της ζωής» μέσα από τη βιβλική ιστορία και θα δούμε πώς οδηγεί στον Ιησού, ο οποίος εμφανίζεται ως αυτός που φέρνει το ζωντανό νερό σε έναν κόσμο που είναι απελπισμένα διψασμένος. 

#BibleProject #ΝερόΤηςΖωής #BibleVideo

videos.title: Will Israel Be Formed by God's Wisdom? • Deuteronomy Ep. 4
videos.description:
Learn how the law was intended to form Israel into people of wisdom, justice, and righteousness. Join Tim and Jon as they start discussing the theme of the law in the second movement of Deuteronomy.

In this episode, you'll learn …

Why Moses gives Israel the law ... again
The law's connection to righteousness
How the biblical authors viewed Israel's laws
How Israel understood the purpose of their laws
What Yahweh's laws were meant to accomplish
The meaning of judgment and righteousness in relation to the law
How a reader of the Torah might practically utilize wisdom from the law to bring about righteousness within a community
How modern readers can also be formed by the law

Browse our entire channel for more podcast episodes and animated videos that help people experience the Bible as a unified story that leads to Jesus.

videos.title: Wisdom of Ecclesiastes • Wisdom Ep. 3
videos.description: In this episode, Tim and Jon begin their discussion on the book of Ecclesiastes. This is an interesting book in Scripture, and the author is relentlessly trying to get the reader to rethink their black and white mindset. It can be a bit depressing to read, and it doesn’t quite give you the same type of feel-good wisdom that the book of Proverbs does. The guys will try to get at what this book is trying to teach us and what the author thinks it means to live a good and godly life.

videos.title: Witness
videos.description:
In the Bible, the word “witness” is used to describe both a person and an action—someone who sees something and then talks about what they’ve seen. Similar to today, this word is used in both legal settings and to describe an experience with God. But what’s most interesting about the word witness is how it illuminates the story of Scripture, especially the role of the people of God. In this video, we explore how this word contributes to the overarching story of the Bible.

#BibleProject #Witness #BibleVideo

el.title: Μελέτη Λέξης: Μάρτυς - "Μάρτυρας"
el.description:
Στη Βίβλο, η λέξη "μάρτυρας" χρησιμοποείται για να περιγράψει τόσο έναν άνθρωπο όσο και μια πράξη--κάποιον που βλέπει κάτι και έπειτα, μιλά για ό,τι έχει δει. Παρομοίως σήμερα, η λέξη χρησιμοποιείται σε νομικά πλαίσια και για να περιγράψει μια εμπειρία με τον Θεό. Όμως, το πιο ενδιαφέρον σχετικά με αυτήν τη λέξη είναι το πως ρίχνει φως στην ιστορία των Γραφών, ειδικά στον ρόλο των ανθρώπων του Θεού. Σε αυτό το βίντεο, εξερευνούμε το πώς αυτή η λέξη συνεισφέρει στην κεντρική ιστορία της Βίβλου.

#BibleProject #Witness #BibleVideo #Μάρτυρας #Μαρτυρώ #Μαρτυρία

videos.title: Writing Styles of the Bible & Why They're Important to Understand
videos.description:
Episode 3 shows how reading the Bible wisely requires that we learn about the ancient literary styles used by the biblical authors. These writers expressed their ideas and claims through a variety of different types of literature, and this video will explore why it's important to tell them apart so we can hear their message on their terms.

#Bible #BibleProject #BibleVideo

es.title: Estilos literarios en la Biblia
es.description: Este es el episodio 3 de una serie de cursos llamados "Cómo leer la Biblia",  que explora el origen, contenido y propósito de la Biblia. Leer la Biblia sabiamente requiere que aprendamos sobre los antiguos estilos literarios  usados por los autores bíblicos. Estos escritores expresaron sus ideas y argumentos a través de una variedad de diferentes tipos de literatura, y este video explorará por qué es importante diferenciarlos y reconocerlos para que podamos escuchar su mensaje en sus términos.

sl.title: Kako brati Sveto pismo: Literarne zvrsti
sl.description:
Tretja epizoda pokaže, kako je za branje Svetega pisma potrebno, da se poučimo o antičnih literarnih zvrsteh, ki jih uporabljajo svetopisemski avtorji. Ti pisatelji so svoje misli in trditve izrazili s pomočjo različnih tipov literature in ta video raziskuje, zakaj je pomembno, da jih razlikujemo. Tako namreč lahko slišimo njihovo sporočilo na njihov način.
Prevod v slovenščino: Svetopisemska družba Slovenije.

videos.title: You Can Understand the Old Testament (2 Simple Ideas Help!)
videos.description:
This session is from the BibleProject Classroom class Introduction to the Hebrew Bible taught by Dr. Tim Mackie. The entire class is available for free on the BibleProject app at https://classroom-beta.bibleproject.com/introduction-to-the-hebrew-bible.

How can we read the Old Testament and understand the meaning its ancient authors intended? 

These two simple ideas are at the core of the process.
1. The Old Testament is an ancient text.
2.  A text is intentional literary communication. 

We interpret every text we read through the lens of our mental storehouse, or the "encyclopedia" of words, ideas, images, and stories stowed in our memories. But the biblical authors have their own encyclopedias from which they produce texts. So if we want to understand the authors' intended meaning, we will adapt our “encyclopedia of reception” by learning about the authors' “encyclopedia of production.” Dive into this class session with Dr. Tim Mackie and start developing tools for encountering the Old Testament on its own terms.
